# Frontend engineering

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

The web client of a product: the HTML, the CSS, and the JavaScript that run in the browser.

## Notes

The concepts of this lane are progressive enhancement and Core Web Vitals. Progressive enhancement makes the core of each page work first. Core Web Vitals measure the experience of real users.

## References

- You measure or improve the speed of a web page. Read [Core Web Vitals](core-web-vitals.md).
- You build the core content or a core function of a page. Read [Progressive enhancement](progressive-enhancement.md).
